metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins by yurifws: commit conventions, security guard-rails, and a default working persona.

plugins.name: commit-craft
plugins.description: Conventional Commits authoring and a consistent pull request description format. Proposes messages for approval; never commits on its own.

plugins.name: guard-rails
plugins.description: Blocks writes containing recognisable credentials, and injects repository state and rules at session start. This plugin can refuse actions.
